name: io.github.Dicka18/mailgate
title: MailGate
description: Self-hosted Cloudflare Workers OTP and magic-link email inbox MCP server for E2E auth testing.

packageArguments.description: Starts the stdio MCP server subcommand.

environmentVariables.name: MAILGATE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your self-hosted MailGate Cloudflare Worker (e.g. https://mailgate.example.com)

environmentVariables.name: MAILGATE_ADMIN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional admin token enabling create_inbox, clear_messages, and simulate_email tools
